cases.given: A transcript describes an emergency but no help button event exists
cases.assert: incident.help_requested remains unknown and spoken_text says help request not confirmed

cases.given: The app emits help_request but Meta STT returns no final transcript
cases.assert: spoken_text still says emergency assistance requested

cases.given: Meta STT emits an interim transcript
cases.assert: reject it; only is_final=true transcripts enter incident history

cases.given: A final Meta STT transcript is accepted
cases.assert: retain its exact text, provider, confidence, speaker and timestamp
breathing remains unknown rather than absent

cases.given: Operator location and authorized device coordinates are available
cases.assert: spoken_text uses the operator location; otherwise it uses device coordinates and accuracy

cases.given: Location comes from IP geolocation or invalid coordinates
cases.assert: reject it and never present it as patient location

cases.given: A transcript proposes patient.breathing=banana or a negative age
cases.assert: reject the event before context reduction

cases.given: An event session_id differs from the context session_id
Speech attempts to set incident.help_requested or app help attempts to set patient status

cases.assert: accept identical content idempotently and reject changed content

cases.given: The same events arrive in different network order
cases.assert: current facts and normalized conflicts are identical

cases.given: Normal breathing is reported and a later report says gasping
cases.assert: retain both transcripts, use the later report and disclose the conflict

cases.given: The dispatcher confirms a fact after an operator report
cases.assert: spoken_text attributes the current fact to the dispatcher

cases.given: One transcript describes multiple patients without stable identifiers
cases.assert: mark multiple_patients unresolved and do not merge patient facts

cases.given: The dispatcher asks whether the patient is unconscious or gasping
cases.assert: mark the transcript as a question and do not update incident facts
explicit help, location and test-call paths remain usable

cases.given: A client submits a real emergency number
cases.assert: reject it; resolve only the server-side test_dispatcher destination
